payload.title: Hardness of Root-Dependent Spanning-Tree Optimization
payload.statement:
Given an undirected graph $G=(V,E)$ and, for each root $r\in V$, an arc-cost vector $c_r$, prove that it is NP-hard to find a spanning tree $T$ minimizing

$$\sum_{r\in V}c_r(T^r),$$

where $T^r$ is the arborescence rooted at $r$ induced by $T$.
